preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly two lines.
The first line contains an integer n within the range [1, 65000].
The second line contains a string s of length exactly n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '123456789' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of digits from 1 to 9.

postconditions.expression: result = int(stdout.strip()); result == sum(1 for i in range(n) for j in range(i, n) if int(s[i:j+1]) % 2 == 0)
postconditions.description: The output is the count of all substrings s[i...j] (0-indexed) that represent an even number.

postconditions.expression: result == sum((n - i) for i in range(n) if int(s[i]) % 2 == 0)
postconditions.description: The count is equivalent to summing (n - i) for every index i where the digit s[i] is even, since a number is even if and only if its last digit is even.
